name: wire-managed-backend-services
job: Wire leftover managed BaaS capabilities with quota and behavioral-proof honesty.

inScope: Naming leftover capabilities as jobs (flags, search, analytics, AI gateway, consent)
Authenticating on the correct management or runtime plane
Wiring one leftover capability end-to-end with write-then-read proof
outOfScope: Sign-in, durable app data, background work, and message delivery listings
Unmaintained free MCP backend plugins as production authority
Routing production secrets through ephemeral paste hosts

inputs: Required leftover capabilities: flags, search, analytics, AI gateway, consent
BaaS candidate matrix and quota classes
outputs: End-to-end behavioral proof per wired capability
Gaps: unshipped services, plan limits, missing tokens
failureSemantics: Preview or unshipped services fail closed and are never faked; every wired leftover capability needs a real postcondition proof (flag evaluates, index returns, event accepted, model routes).

outcome.observable: Leftover managed backend capabilities wired end-to-end with documented auth planes and at least one behavioral proof per capability, plus an honest gap list for unshipped services, plan limits, or missing tokens.
